findings.description: Corporate invoicing service hardcoded literal 'CTH' prefix in call to public.allocate_invoice_number, triggering INVOICE_SERIES_PREFIX_CONFLICT under CGST Rule 46.
findings.remediation: Refactored to query public.invoice_sequence dynamically for approved active series for seller GSTIN and FY, failing closed with UNAUTHORIZED_INVOICE_SERIES if unapproved.

findings.description: resolveIndianFiscalYear(null) evaluated new Date(null) as epoch 0 (1970-01-01), erroneously resolving to fiscal year 1969 instead of failing closed.
findings.remediation: Added explicit check for null, undefined, and empty string to strictly throw INVALID_ISSUE_DATE error.

findings.description: Migration unconditionally updates SAFE-TEST, CONC, FYBND, and LKTEST to approval_status = 'APPROVED' with synthetic authorized_by = 'ca_audit_signed'.
findings.remediation: Documented statutory policy: Migration c7_12 must NOT be applied to staging/production with lines 38-51 enabled. Production approvals must be granted exclusively via authenticated Finance Controller sign-off in Admin UI or signed CA production migration.

findings.description: Protected master database cth_test remained completely untouched with exactly zero state divergence before and after audit.
10 simultaneous asynchronous transactions allocated contiguous sequence numbers (000005 to 000014) with zero deadlocks and zero sequence burning on replay.
